Lunch logged from description (no photo): 160g cooked hamburger patty (same per-100g rate as prior beef-patty entries), 150g baked potatoes (same reference as 11 Jul), a lettuce & tomato salad (2 lettuce leaves/pieces + 3 tomatoes, ~390g) dressed with olive oil and lemon juice (simpler than the usual Maple-Balsamic vinaigrette — no vinegar/mustard/maple this time), 4 spoons (~80g) of homemade cherry-tomato matbucha, and a small dark chocolate praline.
